title: Holdings table hides quantity and shows a bare dash when the price is stale

delivered: Added PortfolioMarkStatus, side, markStatus, and lastMarkAt to PortfolioHoldingMonitorRow and markStatus/lastMarkAt to HoldingRow in src/lib/v5/management/portfolio.ts.

Updated adaptPortfolioHoldingMonitorRow and adaptPortfolioHoldingRows in src/lib/bff-v1/management.ts to adapt mark_status, last_mark_at, and side from BFF holding rows without recomputing market_value from stale prices or inventing a currency.

Added the Quantity column to the holdings table in src/management/pages/oversight/PortfolioBook.tsx showing the signed BFF quantity for every row, rendering Short position / 空頭部位 for negative quantities, and rendering the dash — (never 0) when quantity is missing.

Updated the Market value cell in src/management/pages/oversight/PortfolioBook.tsx to state Price stale (last mark YYYY-MM-DD) / 報價過期（最後報價 YYYY-MM-DD） when mark_status is stale, No price available / 無可用報價 when mark_status is unavailable, and preserve fmtHoldingMoney for rows with mark_status available.

Updated the Source confidence cell in src/management/pages/oversight/PortfolioBook.tsx so rows with mark_status === 'stale' or telemetry_stale === true render a warning-toned stale badge instead of a success-toned ok badge and omit the contradicting 'No reported source issue' line, while healthy rows keep their ok badge and 'No reported source issue' display.

Updated the Unrealized PnL cell in src/management/pages/oversight/PortfolioBook.tsx so null/unavailable unrealized_pnl keeps the visual dash — while exposing accessible text (aria-label, title, and sr-only text) stating 'Source reports no average cost' / '來源未提供平均成本'.

Added bilingual i18n keys (shortPosition, markStale, markStaleWithDateFmt, markUnavailable, noAverageCost, staleTelemetry, noReportedSourceIssue) in src/i18n/locales/en-US.ts and src/i18n/locales/zh-TW.ts with 1:1 parity.

Configured horizontal table scroll width (minScrollWidth={1520}, min-w-[1520px], whitespace-nowrap cells/headers) in src/management/pages/oversight/PortfolioBook.tsx and verified horizontal scrolling with zero column overlap at a 1440px viewport in e2e/19-management-persona-100-flows.spec.ts.
not_changed: Did not modify any backend or BFF code.
Did not recompute market_value from stale prices or fill in a default currency when currency is null.
